title: recall.raw.received.v1
description: A recall notice as received from an external agency feed, lightly normalized. Producer: ingestion services (Person 1). Consumer: resolution-service (Person 3). The `raw` object is the untouched source record; all parsing intelligence (lot extraction, product resolution) belongs downstream.

event_id.description: Unique per event; also set as the AMQP message_id. Consumers dedupe on this.

occurred_at.description: When the ingestion service observed the notice (RFC 3339, UTC).

producer.description: Service name that emitted the event, e.g. ingestion-fda.

source.description: Which upstream feed the record came from.

source_id.description: The feed's own identifier for the notice (openFDA recall_number, FSIS field_recall_number, RASFF reference, RSS guid). Unique within `source`.

source_url.description: Human-readable page for the notice, when the feed provides one.

published_at.description: The feed's own timestamp for the notice (report_date, recall_date, pubDate, notification date). Null if the feed does not provide one.

code_info.description: Lot / batch / date-code text verbatim from the feed. Not parsed here.

classification.description: Feed's own severity label verbatim (e.g. 'Class I', 'High - Class I', 'alert').

raw.description: The untouched upstream record (JSON object as returned by the API, or the RSS item fields).
